rejected_rule.statement: The Court has jurisdiction to decide the question of title to the land where all the parties interested have not appeared before the Acquiring Officer.
rejected_rule.supporting_quote: The Court's jurisdiction is limited by the Ordinance; it is either to make an award as to the amount of compensation where the claimants and the Government Agent are disagreed on that point, or to decide the question of title to the land where there is any dispute among the claimants or where all the parties interested have not appeared before the Government Agent.
